title: Harvard Bets Big on Bitcoin With $443M Stake, Outpacing Gold 2-to-1
summary: Harvard University increased its Bitcoin ETF holdings by 257% to $443 million in the third quarter, making it the institution's largest disclosed position and outpacing gold allocations 2-to-1 despite subsequent market losses.
